CIVICSUITE / CIVICBOARDS PUBLIC SAMPLE

Board rosters, terms, and vacancies without spreadsheet drift.

CivicBoards demonstrates board and commission administration support: roster stubs, term reminders, vacancy checklists, attendance review, and public-records-aware exports without making appointments or legal determinations.

v0.1.1 board administration foundation

SAMPLE BOARD ROSTER

Planning Commission
 Draft sample board file
Staff review packet
Confirm enabling authority, appointment body, term length, quorum rule, and vacancy rule.
Track upcoming term ends and public vacancy notices.
Preserve agendas, packets, minutes, attendance, and appointment records.

TERMS

Reminders, not reappointments

CivicBoards surfaces term-end deadlines; staff decide eligibility and appointment timing.

VACANCIES

Public notice ready

Vacancy helpers collect seat, term, authority, application-window, and notice-review context.

ATTENDANCE

Review flags

Attendance summaries flag review needs without removing or replacing members.

BOUNDARY

No appointment decisions

CivicBoards does not appoint members, remove members, make legal determinations, call live LLMs, publish official notices, or replace the clerk's board system of record.

CivicBoards is part of the Apache 2.0 CivicSuite open-source municipal AI project.
